title: Your Fish Are Null And Void
description: Okay, this caught me off guard when a friend told me, but apparently you can fish in the void. You need [a real special hook](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/void_hook.png:124:62), but it can be done, and apparently you can get some real unique fish. The End is probably the easiest place to do this, but there's a rare species of fish found underground called the [Chasm Eel](image:tide:textures/item/chasm_eel.png:50:50), it can be used to break even bedrock.
